extends CanvasLayer

## F3-toggled development telemetry. This is a dev tool, not a HUD (VS-9 owns
## the HUD). Shows build identity, session state, perf monitors, log tail.

const REFRESH_SECONDS := 0.25
const TAIL_LINES := 6

@onready var text: RichTextLabel = $Text

var _refresh := 0.0


func _ready() -> void:
	visible = false


func _unhandled_key_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	var key := event as InputEventKey
	if key != null and key.pressed and not key.echo and key.keycode == KEY_F3:
		visible = not visible


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_refresh += delta
	if _refresh < REFRESH_SECONDS or not visible:
		return
	_refresh = 0.0

	var net_state: String
	match Session.mode:
		Session.Mode.HOST:
			net_state = "host #%d" % Net.local_peer_id()
		Session.Mode.CLIENT:
			net_state = "client #%d" % Net.local_peer_id()
		_:
			net_state = "solo"

	var lines: Array[String] = [
		Version.label(),
		"mode=%s seed=%d net=%s" % [
			String(Session.Mode.keys()[Session.mode]).to_lower(),
			Session.seed_value, net_state,
		],
		"fps=%d frame=%.2fms physics=%.2fms" % [
			Engine.get_frames_per_second(),
			Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PROCESS) * 1000.0,
			Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS) * 1000.0,
		],
		"",
	]
	lines.append_array(Log.ring.slice(maxi(0, Log.ring.size() - TAIL_LINES)))
	text.text = "\n".join(lines)

## Solo/debug presentation of the same authored operation shell used by
## network sessions. Gameplay orchestration remains in the mission/network layer.

func _ready() -> void:
	var operation := OperationShell.new()
	operation.name = "Operation"
	add_child(operation)

	var cam := get_node_or_null("Camera3D") as Camera3D
	if cam != null:
		cam.position = Vector3(38, 42, 50)
		cam.look_at(OperationLayout.pois().core, Vector3.UP)

extends RefCounted
## Test case: invalid state transitions are rejected, logged, and change nothing.

const Util := preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_util.gd")
const Defs := preload("res://mission/defs.gd")
const KernelScript := preload("res://mission/mission_kernel.gd")


func run() -> Dictionary:
	var t := Util.new()
	t.case_name = "invalid_transitions"

	# --- BOOT: nothing but CONFIGURE works
	var boot_k := KernelScript.new()
	var cfg: Dictionary = t.load_cfg("mission_default.json")
	for c in [[Defs.CMD_SET_RISK, {"mode": "GREEDY"}], [Defs.CMD_START_WAVE, {}],
			[Defs.CMD_REQUEST_WITHDRAWAL, {}], [Defs.CMD_CORE_DAMAGE, {"amount": 5}]]:
		var r: Dictionary = boot_k.cmd(c[0], c[1])
		t.ok(not r.accepted, "BOOT rejects %s" % c[0])
	t.eq(boot_k.phase, Defs.BOOT, "BOOT unchanged")

	# double configure
	var dup := KernelScript.new()
	t.ok(dup.configure(cfg).accepted, "first configure accepted")
	t.ok(not dup.configure(cfg).accepted, "second configure rejected")

	# invalid config
	var bad: Dictionary = cfg.duplicate(true)
	bad.erase("waves")
	var bad_k := KernelScript.new()
	t.ok(not bad_k.configure(bad).accepted, "invalid config rejected")

	# --- SCOUT gates
	var h = t.Harness.create(cfg, "balanced")
	var k = h.k
	t.eq(k.phase, Defs.SCOUT, "harness kernel in SCOUT before start")
	var rej_before: int = k.telemetry.count_kind(Defs.EV_REJECTED)
	t.ok(not k.cmd(Defs.CMD_REQUEST_WITHDRAWAL).accepted, "SCOUT withdrawal rejected (no quota)")
	t.ok(not k.cmd(Defs.CMD_BATCH_RESOLVED, {"batch_id": "GHOST"}).accepted, "unknown batch rejected")
	t.ok(not k.cmd(Defs.CMD_ASSET_LOST, {"asset_id": "NOPE"}).accepted, "unknown asset rejected")
	k.cmd(Defs.CMD_ASSET_REGISTERED, {"asset_id": "T1", "type": "TURRET_MG"})
	t.ok(not k.cmd(Defs.CMD_ASSET_REGISTERED, {"asset_id": "T1", "type": "TURRET_MG"}).accepted,
		"duplicate asset id rejected")
	t.ok(not k.cmd(Defs.CMD_CORE_DAMAGE, {"amount": 0}).accepted, "zero damage rejected")
	t.ok(not k.cmd(Defs.CMD_EX_CREDIT, {"amount": -5}).accepted, "negative EX credit rejected")
	t.ok(not k.cmd("SOMETHING_ELSE").accepted, "unknown command rejected")
	t.eq(k.telemetry.count_kind(Defs.EV_REJECTED) - rej_before, 7, "rejections logged with reasons")
	t.eq(k.phase, Defs.SCOUT, "phase untouched by rejections")

	# --- ASSAULT gates
	k.cmd(Defs.CMD_START_WAVE)
	t.eq(k.phase, Defs.ASSAULT, "wave started")
	t.ok(not k.cmd(Defs.CMD_START_WAVE).accepted, "double START_WAVE rejected")
	t.ok(not k.cmd(Defs.CMD_REQUEST_WITHDRAWAL).accepted, "pre-quota withdrawal rejected QUOTA_NOT_MET")
	t.ok(not k.cmd(Defs.CMD_BATCH_RESOLVED, {"batch_id": "W9-B999"}).accepted, "foreign batch id rejected")

	# --- WITHDRAWAL gates
	while not k.quota_met:
		k.cmd(Defs.CMD_EX_CREDIT, {"amount": 100000})
	t.ok(k.cmd(Defs.CMD_REQUEST_WITHDRAWAL).accepted, "withdrawal after quota accepted")
	t.eq(k.phase, Defs.WITHDRAWAL, "in WITHDRAWAL")
	var flip := "SAFE" if k.risk_id != "SAFE" else "GREEDY"
	t.ok(not k.cmd(Defs.CMD_SET_RISK, {"mode": flip}).accepted, "risk locked during extraction")
	t.ok(not k.cmd(Defs.CMD_START_WAVE).accepted, "START_WAVE during extraction rejected")

	# --- CONCLUDED gates
	var guard := 0
	while k.phase != Defs.CONCLUDED and guard < 5000:
		guard += 1
		k.advance(float(k.cfg.timing.fixed_step_ms) / 1000.0)
	for c in [Defs.CMD_START_WAVE, Defs.CMD_SET_RISK, Defs.CMD_REQUEST_WITHDRAWAL,
			Defs.CMD_CORE_DAMAGE, Defs.CMD_EX_CREDIT, Defs.CMD_ASSET_LOST]:
		t.ok(not k.cmd(c, {"amount": 5, "mode": "SAFE", "asset_id": "T1"}).accepted,
			"CONCLUDED rejects %s" % c)
	t.eq(k.outcome.get("outcome", ""), "SUCCESS", "withdrawal completed successfully")
	return t.result()

extends SceneTree
## Headless test runner: godot --headless --path labs/mission_kernel \
##   --script res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_runner.godot
## Writes results/test_report.json, exits non-zero on failure.

const CASES := [
	preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_safe_full.gd"),
	preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_greedy_full.gd"),
	preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_switch_safe_to_greedy.gd"),
	preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_switch_greedy_to_safe.gd"),
	preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_core_destroyed.gd"),
	preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_early_extraction.gd"),
	preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_continue_for_more.gd"),
	preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_three_waves.gd"),
	preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_invalid_transitions.gd"),
	preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_deterministic_replay.gd"),
	preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_quota_unmet.gd"),
	preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_advance_fractional.gd"),
]


func _initialize() -> void:
	var results: Array = []
	var failed := 0
	for case_script in CASES:
		var case = case_script.new()
		var r: Dictionary = case.run()
		results.append(r)
		var mark := "PASS" if r.pass else "FAIL"
		print("[%s] %s (%d checks)" % [mark, r.name, r.checks])
		if not r.pass:
			failed += 1
			for f in r.failures:
				print("      - %s" % f)

	var passed := results.size() - failed
	print("%d/%d cases passed" % [passed, results.size()])
	_dump_report(results, passed)
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)


func _dump_report(results: Array, passed: int) -> void:
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute("res://results")
	var f := FileAccess.open("res://results/test_report.json", FileAccess.WRITE)
	if f == null:
		return
	f.store_string(JSON.stringify({
		"runner": "mission_kernel_test_runner",
		"godot": Engine.get_version_info().string,
		"timestamp": Time.get_datetime_string_from_system(true),
		"passed": passed,
		"total": results.size(),
		"cases": results,
	}, "\t", true))
	f.close()

extends RefCounted
## Test case: SAFE full run - 3 waves, contract completes at full duration.

const Util := preload("res://tests/orchestrators/kernel/test_util.gd")


func run() -> Dictionary:
	var t := Util.new()
	t.case_name = "safe_full_run"
	var h = t.Harness.create(t.load_cfg("mission_default.json"), "balanced")
	t.ok(h.k.phase == "SCOUT", "starts in SCOUT")
	t.auto_run(h, func(_p, _w): return "", func(_h): return h.k.final_lull)

	t.eq(h.k.outcome.get("outcome", ""), "SUCCESS", "operation succeeds")
	t.eq(h.k.phase, "CONCLUDED", "terminal state reached")
	t.eq(h.k.waves_completed, 3, "all three waves completed")
	t.eq(h.k.state().kpis.extraction_timing, "FULL", "extraction timing FULL")
	t.ok(h.k.core_hp > 0, "core survived")
	t.ok(h.k.quota_met, "quota met")
	t.eq(h.k.telemetry.count_kind("CONTRACT_READY"), 1, "CONTRACT_READY fired exactly once")
	t.eq(h.k.telemetry.count_kind("COMMAND_REJECTED"), 0, "no rejected commands in happy path")
	t.ok(h.k.ex_mex >= int(h.k.cfg.extraction.quota_mex), "extracted >= quota")
	return t.result()
